item.title: Re: Sex Toy Security and WiGLE popularity: Privacy and security are crucial, especially in areas people might not think about—like connected devices. It’s good to see discussions like this bringing awareness in a responsible way. -avrorafrix

Re: Instructors Using WiGLE: arkasha wrote: > Please reach out with an email explaining your intended use before you direct your class to create accounts with WiGLE - we can help! I started personally just interested in the potential RF interference to devices that I was working with to design, after seeing so many medical devices originally that were having a few interference problems. Reviewing the large amount of RF in the world these days made me work so that designs would be certain that RF interference would not normally be a problem. I'm only interested in the frequent occurrence of RF worldwide, never the access to anything - WIGLE maps have always been fascinating! Thanks! -ecramp
Re: Instructors Using WiGLE: make sure you're logging in using your username, not your email address. -arkasha

Re: Instructors Using WiGLE: I'm trying to help out and show my daughter how to do things in cyber community and plus I drive my kids around the tri states all the time .. I tired to log in but no luck .. -fizsrp

Re: 23 years of WiGLE: Congrats on such a successful hobby/project!! I am very proud to be a part of it all. WiGLE was my first intro to wardriving (found by accident) and helped to grow my interest in the field of wireless security and related tech. Cheers to many more years \m/ -Stratt3000

Re: 23 years of WiGLE: Haven't been a part of the community very long but I did want to say that this project is very cool. I wish I knew about it sooner. I knew about CellMapper before this project, and someone in the CellMapper community mentioned this app, and now I feel like it's a game to get my seen networks as big as possible! Here's to another 20 years! *cheers* -CalebM
Re: 23 years of WiGLE: Nick2bad4u wrote: > Don't forget us War-Bicyclsts! Nobody is forgetting about warcycling or warcyclists. We are out there in numbers. -toothpaste

Re: 23 years of WiGLE: Thanks to the crearors, maintainers and explainers of wigle, Thanks to everyone making inspiring projects and/or just putting up bulk numbers. I was an occasional, read-only user of this amazing public service until the last year or so where it has quickly become a favorite activity for me and I've been setting and breaking personal goals since then. Shouts to wiglers,.making dreams come true -computerb0y
